target_customer: Private equity and deal teams that source off-market acquisition targets
problem: Finding and contacting owners of private companies is slow manual outreach. Q2Q finds matching companies, drafts personalized outreach for approval and books first calls.
business_model: B2B SaaS for deal teams (pricing not stated)
product_category: AI outbound deal sourcing for private equity

founders.name: Brianna Lin
previous_startups: Copperlane (current co-founding role per YC profile)
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page, which shows one founder profile for a team of two.

competitors.name: Meridian
competitors.what: AI sourcing for private equity deals

technical_complexity.rationale: Company discovery, contact enrichment and LLM-drafted outreach with human approval use common components; the difficulty is data quality and deliverability.

defensibility.rationale: Established databases and several AI sourcing startups offered similar workflows, so a copy took weeks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action specifically against Q2Q was found.

market_need_then: PE firms pay for sourcing databases and outbound services, and AI sourcing tools drew funding in 2025. Direct evidence of demand for Q2Q was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses tryq2q.com (try prefix); acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Bold, short and playful (Never Sleeps, your personal AI intern team)

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search for the name returned only unrelated Q2 and QQ brands, so the name is easily confused and shows no brand press.

outcome_analysis: Q2Q was a winter 2026 AI outbound tool for PE deal sourcing. The YC directory lists it as inactive, but no shutdown notice, acquisition or post-mortem was found and its website still describes the product, so the cause of the inactive status is not public. No traction figures were found.
notes: The $500K entry rests on one database (VCBacked) and equals YC's standard deal, so stage is other. A search summary said the YC page names Claire Wu as CTO, but the fetched YC page showed only Brianna Lin, so she is not listed as a founder. Altss marks the company inactive. Only one dated competitor was found; Grata and SourceScrub appear in undated comparison pages. Audit check of Claire Wu: the raw YC page (fetched again 2026-11) lists Harshita Arora and Brianna Lin and does not contain the name Claire Wu, while a search summary repeatedly says the YC page lists Claire Wu as CTO (background hedge fund engineer and Qualtrics product). No opened source confirms her, so she is not added as a founder.
